Raditya's Room

A stylized 3D bedroom for the IF B virtual room project

Creative Concept

This space is an individual 3D bedroom designed specifically for Raditya. The aesthetic draws inspiration from cozy life-simulation games like Unpacking and Animal Crossing, featuring warm oak flooring, creamy beige walls, soft sage bedding, and personal wall memories.

Interactive Features

  • Wall Gallery: Click any of the wooden wall frames to inspect photo memories and details.
  • Gaming TV Station: Click the TV or controller to power on the display and launch configured games.
  • Bedside Lamp: Click the bedside lamp or use the top button to toggle warm room lighting.
  • Day & Night Presets: Switch between golden morning sunlight and a cozy evening twilight atmosphere.

Configuration

Photos, captions, dimensions, and the external game destination are modularly managed in src/config/roomConfig.js.
